records.Name: Taffy
records.Description: Your lone co-worker at the ACD. A natural-born layabout who despises nothing more than going to the office. While she may seem lackadaisical and unreliable, no one comes in clutch like she can.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 新人调查员
蓝猫物流员工

records.Name: Seymour
records.Description: A somewhat self-important hacker who is perpetually wearing a mask unsuitable for the occasion. He may be peculiar, but he knows what he’s doing. Having him is bound to makes a job go smoother.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: Hacker

records.Name: Richie
records.Description: A new NCCA recruit prone to bouts of absent-mindedness, which nevertheless does not prevent her from being effective at her job. She’s a model partner who possesses astonishing strength, along with a fearsome appetite to match.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: NCCA Officer

records.Name: Mechanika
records.Description: An easy-going and guileless Chaos inventor who watches over her peculiar flock of unruly sheep. Seemingly bereft of any character flaws, she almost comes off not human. One wonders what her dark side would be like…
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 民间发明家

records.Name: Garm
records.Description: The big cheese of the Demon Canine Society, or DK9. Comes off as intimidating due to her proclivity for speaking bluntly. Not averse to getting physical in order to solve problems. A trustworthy ally.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 犬魔社继承人
格斗大师

records.Name: Lykaia
records.Description: Director of the NCCA, and a prominent figure in Nova City. Can make 99% of traffic tickets disappear. Gives the feeling that she’s plotting something big, but is perpetually short on manpower, thus her frequent attempts to undermine the ACD.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 巡卫署长

records.Name: Suzu
records.Description: A paparazzo who knows ninjutsu. Will do anything for a sensational scoop.
records.UnlockClue: Can meet during the Anomalies [Ninja Journalist] mission.
Title: Reporter
忍术大师

records.Name: Anonym
records.Description: The owner of Shannon Diary and the new landlord of the ACD building. While she can initially come off cold and calculating, she in fact a perfectly reasonable and approachable person.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: Owner of Shannon Dairy

records.Name: Aileen
records.Description: The owner of the Dream Garden Cafe. Obsessed with martial arts from Chongxiao. Appears innocent and harmless on the surface, when in reality it’s a completely different story
records.UnlockClue: Was spotted at the Dream Garden Cafe in Glimmergold.
Title: 梦花园店主
格斗高手

records.Name: Bansy
records.Description: A free-spirited graffiti artist who seems connected somehow with Harru coming into existence. Her schedule is jam-packed, as she’s always letting her creativity unfold on the streets or roaming the alleyways and avenues in search of inspiration.
records.UnlockClue: Was spotted at a record shop.
Title: Street Artist

records.Name: Mimiko
records.Description: The top streamer around, and Taffy’s best friend. Runs her mouth and constantly throws shade during her streams, but becomes paralyzingly timid when offline. Can only cut loose amongst close friends. Currently struggling to remain relevant.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 游戏主播

records.Name: Ringo
records.Description: A student who can call herself Taffy’s “second-best friend.” A seasoned keyboard warrior with more aliases than you can shake a stick at. Spends her days online beefing with trolls. Worships the ACD and dreams of one day joining the Yeet Squad.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 在读学生

records.Name: Alan
records.Description: A B-Tier streetball influencer. The textbook definition of impassioned, he could spend all afternoon talking to a dog on the street. He is consumed with the desire to accrue more followers, and is fixated on riding the coattails of the Yeet Master’s popularity.
records.UnlockClue: Can meet during the Anomalies [Peak Performance] mission.
Title: 街球网红

records.Name: Arms
records.Description: Runs Solution Pawn. If there isn’t money to be made, he isn’t interested. A former crash test dummy with a veritable who’s who of shady connections, which allows him to sneak all sorts of prohibited merchandise past the authorities.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 武器商人

records.Name: Harru
records.Description: A particularly strange Chaos: a talking graffiti pooch which can only traverse via wall surfaces. Wants to escape its two-dimensional confinement in order to travel more places and help others.
records.UnlockClue: Can meet during Anomalies [The Buddy Paws] mission.
Title: 友善的混厄生物

records.Name: Victor
records.Description: A middle-aged office worker who’s down on his luck and put on a few pounds. He takes to the streets to dispense justice while wearing a comic book-inspired outfit he cobbled together, only to end up beaten to a pulp each and every time.
records.UnlockClue: Can meet during the Anomalies [Everyday Superman] mission.
records.MaxTrustRewardDescription: 获得A级武器(涡轮加速锤）
Title: 热心市民
records.__RAW__MaxTrustRewardDescription: 获得A级武器(涡轮加速锤）

records.Name: Qi Fei
records.Description: A racing enthusiast who calls himself Nova City Flying Tiger and who has a real knack for vehicle mods. He sings his own praises to the heavens, when in reality his skills are questionable.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 赛车手

records.Name: Kimball
records.Description: A wheelchair-bound scientist who is an influential figure renowned throughout Nova City. He dreams of creating a perpetual flying machine.
records.UnlockClue: Can meet during Anomalies [The Unreachable] mission.
Title: 阿曼德科技董事

records.Name: Harry
records.Description: A senior officer in the NCCA and Richie’s mentor. Despite his ardor, his personal and professional life are both in shambles.
records.UnlockClue: Can meet during the Anomalies [Safe Driving] mission.
Title: 资深巡卫官

records.Name: Yue
records.Description: A hero who ensures peace throughout the city.
records.UnlockClue: Can meet during the Anomalies [Swing Training] mission.
Title: 城市英雄

records.Name: Likka
records.Description: An industrious nepo baby who runs her own youth employment agency. While she may look green, she in fact runs nearly every aspect of the business herself.
records.UnlockClue: Can meet during the Anomalies [Welcome to Part-timers Paradise] mission.
records.MaxTrustRewardDescription: 获得S级礼物(敲敲乐木鱼）
Title: 职业介绍所老板
records.__RAW__MaxTrustRewardDescription: 获得S级礼物(敲敲乐木鱼）

records.Name: Tie Shan
records.Description: A bronze man Chaos from Chongxiao. The one in the duo who calls the shots. A lifetime spent immersed in martial arts means that his hand-to-hand and sword technique have reached their pinnacle. He has recently developed an interest in firearms and other forms of artillery.
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 武学宗师

records.Name: Master Kuukuu
records.Description: 隐形人空手道家，正烦恼于如何让弟子看到自己的教学。
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 武学高手

records.Name: Jeffrey
records.Description: 蓝猫物流老板，异想天开的富家公子，有钱但穿得很邋遢。
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
records.MaxTrustRewardDescription: 解锁塔菲摩托车灯(占位）
Title: Cat Express Boss
records.__RAW__MaxTrustRewardDescription: 解锁塔菲摩托车灯(占位）

records.Name: Gwen
records.Description: 一个除了本职巡卫官工作外，对其他事都很擅长的社交达人。
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: NCCA Officer

records.Name: Ada
records.Description: 阿曼德科技的研发中心主任，经常好心办坏事的天才发明家。
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
records.MaxTrustRewardDescription: 获得天赋材料(精装传记）
Title: 阿曼德科技发明家
records.__RAW__MaxTrustRewardDescription: 获得天赋材料(精装传记）

records.Name: Mr. Lord
records.Description: 长途跋涉来到新启后，因为无法入乡随俗，在当地处处碰壁的吸血鬼混厄。洛德先生不得已地开始了流浪生涯，努力地生存下去。
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: 落魄的血族

records.Name: Pineapple
records.Description: 喜欢运动的阳光男孩，经常利用黑客技术惩恶扬善。
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: Hacker

records.Name: Sunny
records.Description: 犬魔社成员，战斗能力不俗，擅长乔装与潜入。
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: DK9 Member
格斗大师

records.Name: Klatt
records.Description: 自以为是硬汉的书呆子巡卫官，渴望通过晋升来证明自己。
records.UnlockClue: Progress through the story mission, and you may meet him/her.
Title: NCCA Officer

records.Name: Lemon Sour
records.Description: 温柔、亲和的活力偶像。
records.UnlockClue: 在新启的某处，或许可以结识TA
records.MaxTrustRewardDescription: 热度值带来的粉丝数获取量额外提高20%
